rules.name: no-deep-src-imports
rules.message: Do not import other packages' src; use their public exports (@hierarchidb/*).

rules.name: no-cross-package-relative
rules.message: Cross-package relative imports are forbidden; use workspace package imports.

rules.name: public-types-from-dist
rules.message: Plugins must expose types from dist/*.d.ts via package.json types/exports.types.
